name: Buloki: Escape from the Alien Ship
storyline: Buloki and the other blockmen have been abducted by aliens. Will you help him escape his terrible fate and reunite with the love of his life?
summary:
Are you ready to die and retry?

Buloki has been abducted by aliens! Master grid-based movement, don't fall, avoid traps and patrolling aliens, and find your way out of the ship.

Every mistake is your own. No luck, only skill.

Think you're good at video games?

Prove it.
